motion: Do we need God for morality?

moves.currentDescription: Ferrer uses an empathy deficient agent to argue that moral knowledge can persist without fairness motivation and therefore motivation cannot ground rightness.
moves.lockedProposition: A person lacking fairness or empathy can still possess moral knowledge, showing that motivation cannot ground what is right.

moves.currentDescription: Dillahunty argues that dependence shared space and repeated interaction allow even strong self interest to motivate cooperation and helpful institutions.
moves.lockedProposition: Because people share space and depend on one another, even strong self-interest can motivate altruistic cooperation and institutions that help others.
